theme: Small talk đầu giờ & pantry chat

vocab.example: Nam turned on the kettle before the daily standup started.
vocab.example_vi: Nam bật ấm đun nước trước khi buổi standup hằng ngày bắt đầu.

vocab.meaning_vi: cốc có quai (để uống cà phê, trà)
vocab.example: I left my mug next to the keyboard again this morning.
vocab.example_vi: Sáng nay tôi lại để quên cốc cạnh bàn phím.

vocab.meaning_vi: phòng nghỉ, khu pantry của công ty
vocab.example: The whole backend team eats lunch in the break room on Fridays.
vocab.example_vi: Cả nhóm backend ăn trưa ở phòng nghỉ vào các ngày thứ Sáu.

vocab.example: Would you like a refill before we join the sprint planning call?
vocab.example_vi: Bạn có muốn rót thêm một chút trước khi vào cuộc họp sprint planning không?

vocab.meaning_vi: đi lại một chút cho đỡ mỏi
vocab.example: After three hours of debugging I need to stretch my legs.
vocab.example_vi: Sau ba tiếng debug tôi cần đi lại một chút cho đỡ mỏi.

vocab.meaning_vi: kỳ nghỉ cuối tuần dài (có thêm ngày lễ)
vocab.example: The team looks fresh after a long weekend without any production alerts.
vocab.example_vi: Cả nhóm trông tỉnh táo hẳn sau kỳ nghỉ dài không có cảnh báo production nào.

vocab.example: Linh joined the standup from her phone because of a traffic jam.
vocab.example_vi: Linh vào standup bằng điện thoại vì bị kẹt xe.

vocab.meaning_vi: cây nước (nơi mọi người hay đứng nói chuyện)
vocab.example: Most project news travels faster at the water cooler than by email.
vocab.example_vi: Phần lớn tin tức dự án lan nhanh ở cây nước hơn là qua email.

lines.speaker: Nam (Backend Developer)
lines.text: Morning, Linh. You are early today. Is the kettle already on?

lines.speaker: Linh (QA Engineer)
lines.text: Morning, Nam. Yes, I boiled it. Do you want a refill of coffee?

lines.speaker: Nam (Backend Developer)
lines.text: Yes please. I left my mug on the desk, so give me one minute.

lines.speaker: Linh (QA Engineer)
lines.text: Take your time. The break room is quiet before the daily standup starts.

lines.speaker: Nam (Backend Developer)
lines.text: I really needed this. The traffic jam near the office was terrible this morning.

lines.speaker: Linh (QA Engineer)
lines.text: Same for me. I left home at seven and still arrived a bit late.

lines.speaker: Nam (Backend Developer)
lines.text: Did you enjoy the long weekend? You mentioned a short trip to Da Lat.

lines.speaker: Linh (QA Engineer)
lines.text: It was lovely. We walked every morning, so I came back quite tired.

lines.speaker: Nam (Backend Developer)
lines.text: After the standup I will stretch my legs and get some cold water.

lines.speaker: Linh (QA Engineer)
lines.text: Good idea. People always meet at the water cooler and share project news.

questions.q: Why was Nam late this morning?
options: He was stuck in a traffic jam
He forgot his laptop at home

questions.q: What did Linh do during the long weekend?
options: She took a trip to Da Lat
She stayed at home and slept

questions.q: What will Nam do after the standup?
options: Stretch his legs and get water

shadowing: Morning, Linh. Did you have a good weekend away from work and email?
The kettle is empty again, so let me boil some water for everyone.
Sorry I am late, the traffic jam near the office was really bad.
Let's grab a quick coffee in the break room before the standup starts.
I will stretch my legs for five minutes and refill my mug downstairs.
